name: sideshift
description: Operate your SideShift company from Cursor—manage campaigns, creators, applications, content, contracts, recruiting, messages, payouts, and more through secure OAuth.

skills.name: sideshift-operations
skills.description: Use when the user wants to inspect or operate a SideShift company, including UGC campaigns, creators, recruiting, applications, jobs, contracts, posts, analytics, messaging, invoices, payouts, wallet, settings, or other SideShift workflows through the installed MCP server.

skills.name: sideshift-setup
skills.description: Use when the user needs to install, authorize, troubleshoot, or verify the SideShift MCP connection in ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, or another MCP-compatible host.

commands.name: sideshift-connect
commands.description: Connect SideShift through browser-based OAuth, verify the selected company, and report the granted scopes without requesting or exposing credentials.
